games.name: 🔥HELL🔥Mog or Die
games.description:
🔥 MOG OR DIE 

LIKE GOAL = 300 LIKES FOR CODE

Start as a tiny SUB5 and build yourself into the ultimate MOGGER.

🥛 Drink Milk to grow taller  
🔨 Collect Hammers to improve your Face  
🖼️ Find Picture Frames to build your Frame  
💧 Collect Water to lower your Bodyfat  

Challenge NPCs and real players in MOG BATTLES where your Face, Frame, Height, and Bodyfat are compared.

Win the battle and choo
